methods.name: CREASE
methods.description: Implementation of a machine learning (ML) model (neural network) to directly relate the gene set to the corresponding scattering intensity profile

methods.name: P(q) and S(q) CREASE
methods.description: Development of separate ML models linking the gene set to the structure factor S(q) and form factor P(q) to obtain overall scattering intensity I(q)

methods.name: genetic algorithm
methods.description: Optimizes for the set of genes (low dimensional feature space corresponding to a structural arrangement, S(q), and primary particle form, P(q)) possessing a computed scattering profile that most closely matches the input scattering profile(s).

methods.name: Debye scattering equation
methods.description: Used to directly determine computed scattering profile(s) in CREASE.

methods.name: machine learning (ML) model
methods.description: Used to determine computed scattering profile(s) in CREASE.

methods.name: CREASE for S(q)
methods.description: A previously developed version utilizing 10 different genes to reconstruct the structural arrangement of spherical nanoparticles in solution.

methods.name: Debye scattering approach
methods.description: Calculates computed scattering profiles by first evaluating P(q) and combining it with S(q) to obtain the overall scattering intensity I(q).
